text: haha oh hmm.. im walking thru buildings xD im sure that isnt ur intention haha or was it ? ;O il try on 220 see if they collide or not
resolution: Investigated the report that buildings collide at 220 blocks but not 512. Built a headless collision self-test in the loader that mimics stepNow EXACTLY (live per-frame rebuildWindow recenter, then runPlayerPhysics) and shoved a test player straight into the nearest SOLID building rect at three centers spanning the map — origin, 0.4*radius, 0.85*radius (up to ~9570m from center at 512). Result: BLOCKED at every center, at BOTH 220 and 512 (player stops exactly at face minus radius; one case even pushed back). Also confirmed via diagnostics that colliders are correctly built everywhere at 512 (~290 solid building rects per 448m window, identical to 220) and the spawn is (0,0,0) on the central road intersection. Could NOT reproduce the pass-through headless — collision resolves correctly at 512 across the whole map. The user's earlier 512 log (pasted in req_0369) lacked the '[loader] spatial collider windowing ON' line, so that test almost certainly ran a pre-spatial-collision binary. Removed all diagnostics; the committed spatial collision (1412766a0) is verified to build (ReleaseFast) and block. Need the user to re-test 512 FRESH and confirm the 'windowing ON' line appears in the terminal; if pass-through persists with that line present, next step is a live on-terminal position+near-field-solids readout to capture the failing case.
